flaws.text: "Rules outside a planned project": "In an unplanned repository the review runs with the template's rules and language auto-detection only, and says so" (line 175). `review/rules.py:resolve_rules_dir` at `76bd0251^` resolves CLI flag, config, `{cwd}/rules/`, `{cwd}/.claude/rules/`, then `~/.config/squadron/rules/`, so a review in an unplanned repository can load rules from the repo or the user directory, silently. **VALID** (minor): contradicts code. Not counted: r09 i0 and r02/r03 i0 (PR-head rules as injection channel, not tied to the unplanned-repo claim) and r10 i12 (degradation underspecified, but does not say repo or user rules load).
